power.method: 120 VAC (89-135, 60 Hz, NEMA TS2), 230 VAC (50 Hz), or 24 VAC

features: day (color) / night (mono) switchover, auto or manual
360-degree continuous pan; 0-90 tilt with auto-flip; >250 deg/s preset speed
64 presets, 8 tours, 16 sectors, 8 privacy zones, 2 alarm inputs
opto-isolated RS-232 / RS-422 with digital position feedback (RS-485 available); multiprotocol
NEMA TS2 traffic-control-cabinet rated; integral heaters
release_notes: The Cohu 3920 iDome is an outdoor analog PTZ speed dome for traffic-control (NEMA TS2) systems, with a 1/4-inch CCD, 23x optical zoom, day/night switchover, and 360-degree continuous pan (auto-flip) in a dry-nitrogen-pressurized IP67/NEMA 4X dome housing. Analog composite output with RS-232/RS-422 multiprotocol serial PTZ control; no IP/ONVIF/RTSP. The shared 3920-series manual also covers the 3923 and 3925 iDome variants.
